scope: Static instruction/dataflow map from the selected FieldOutsideTemplate grid to the guarded coast-part instance loop. Local cell spacing is resolved; parent/world transform composition and runtime resource success are unresolved.

terrain_grid_relation.status: exact dimension ratio across source grids; 10-unit terrain-cell spacing is a cross-grid inference, not a proven native transform or origin alignment

call_chain.operation: copy the 16-bit setup value at object +0xe into a temporary grid header field
build the 9x8 UID grid; the wrapper runs the sea fill, interior clear, and copy only when the temporary header low bit is set
write dimensions and 72 UID/x/z records into the selected template resource object
guarded update dispatch for the selected template object
when the object state permits, iterate the template resource's part grid using descriptor type 0x6622bd46

resource_grid_layout.bounds_helper: 0x4e0d80 accepts x<=width and z<=height; caller loops x=0..8 and z=0..7
resource_grid_layout.record_getter: 0x4e0d60 returns records_offset + (z*9+x)*24; out-of-range linear indices fall back to first record

part_instantiation.iteration: 8 rows x 9 columns; skip cells whose UniqueID is zero

lookup.operation: resolve a 16-bit UniqueID against the registered part table's base ID, count, and row-pointer array

position_descriptor.status: native factory descriptor receives exact center-of-cell coordinates; parent/world transform composition remains unresolved

outside_sea_condition.operation: test the resolved row's PartsKind cache index against 0x18 (OutsideSea)
outside_sea_condition.effect: the result selects descriptor option 0 or 2 before the object factory call; the option's engine meaning is unresolved

factory.operation: dispatch one object-construction call for each valid nonzero cell
factory.success: static dispatch is proven; model load, collision creation, and runtime object success are not

limits: The position constants are resolved to 160.0 units per coast cell and a zero base XYZ vector. The object's parent/world transform composition remains unresolved.
No coast-part rotation, terrain-height snapping, seam construction, or collision generation is proven by this path.

Native template generation produced 50-52 nonzero grid records depending on the deterministic tick fixture and empty S_concavity side candidates; the guarded loop skips zero UIDs. This implies 50-52 factory dispatches in those tested templates, not confirmed loaded/rendered objects.
The setup flag copied from object +0xe controls whether the wrapper copies a populated grid; the source field's higher-level meaning is unresolved.
